authority: MapBattleV2 and existing Combat V2 resolvers remain authoritative. Presentation/VFX consumers are read-only and cannot create hits, damage, status, healing, cleanse, or summons.

identity_formats.encounter_id: battle encounter identity; stable for one encounter

common_event_fields.positions: Vector2 values are simulation-space anchors, not screen coordinates

events.lifecycle: one event per actual accepted cast

events.identity: cast_id + event_id when cast exists; otherwise event-sequence fallback
events.lifecycle: one event when actual pending cast releases

events.identity: actual cast ID when carried; otherwise event-sequence fallback
events.lifecycle: only a real rejected/missed cast or placement event

events.identity: cast-scoped event ID when called from a cast; otherwise event-sequence fallback
events.lifecycle: only after authoritative damage settlement; emitted damage is actual committed damage

events.identity: cast-scoped event ID where the originating cast exists; otherwise event-sequence fallback
events.lifecycle: after canonical status state is applied

events.identity: cast-scoped ID for V63 skill heal; event-sequence fallback for generic battle heal
cast-scoped ID when a real cast exists; otherwise event-sequence fallback

events.lifecycle: after a real bounded summon actor is inserted

events.identity: unique attack event ID and hit_event_id; retains actual origin_cast_id
events.lifecycle: only if the matching real Combat V2 hit committed positive damage; source_actor_id is summon, attacker credit remains owner

events.identity: summon_id + /expired; carries original cast identity if known
events.lifecycle: once when actor is removed for its actual expiry/removal reason

events.identity: actual shield cast + protected actor + incrementing absorption sequence; encounter fallback only if cast absent
events.lifecycle: only for capacity consumed by actual incoming damage; incoming_cast_id is optional and is empty for basic attacks

requirements: do not derive damage or hit count from an animation
do not re-run a completed event on presentation replay
use hit_event_id only as a reference to the matching authoritative hit
deduplication.snapshot: continuous snapshots persist event_sequence; actor cast/summon/attack/absorption sequences and event journal are persisted in the existing battle snapshot. Older snapshots without the optional event_sequence remain accepted.

backward_compatibility.event_names_and_existing_payload_fields: preserved; identity and anchor fields are additive
backward_compatibility.legacy_snapshots: optional event_sequence is reconstructed from retained event IDs/event count

qa_source.local_test_source: content-verified reconstructed snapshot; relevant SaveService/runtime/Combat Event/DV2-02 blobs matched live HEAD; DV2-03 test has diagnostic-only failure details
